template.name: Heiken Ashi Simplified EA
template.notes: Heikin Ashi is recursive and not available, so raw candles stand in for it: three consecutive bullish candles approximate the three HA closes above their opens, and the trigger is price moving above the last three-bar high. The decelerating-open series, the DistancePoints 300 filter and the MaxPositions 3 scaling are dropped, and the docs list no stops.
